review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Enumerate all candy allocations within each loyalty cap and total budget. For each allocation compute exact independent vote-mask probabilities; strict-majority masks succeed outright, other masks use A/(A+sum of dissenting levels). At most8 senators/candies makes exhaustive allocation practical and preserves the distinction between voting and appeal.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
